dataIdInfo.idPurp: Calculate solar radiation, effective shade, and gap fraction using Heat Source version 9 solar model and the node feature class produced by TTools.
dataIdInfo.idAbs: Shade-a-lator is used to set up and run Heat Source solar models. Heat Source version 9.1.0 is bundled with this tool. TTools steps 1, 3, 4, and 5 (star pattern) must be run before Shade-a-lator can be used. A land cover code CSV file must also be developed. The model calculates solar radiation flux through the atmosphere to the stream surface providing a timeseries of flux values at different attenuation points (SR1 through SR5). Daily effective shade and gap fraction are also output. The Shade-a-lator model is set up by default to assume no clouds. All model input files can be manually edited if desired. The input nodes feature class is not modified. See the Heat Source user manual for more information.
